exposure: genetic and environmental contributions related to timing of birth
familial recurrence of autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
outcome: Recurrence risk of autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
cohort: Siblings and half-siblings of individuals with ASD born in California between 1990 and 2003
finding: The recurrence risk of ASD was higher in siblings born immediately after the index case and decreased with increasing birth order, suggesting both genetic and birth timing-related environmental factors contribute to ASD recurrence.
